description: Source code for a Bluetooth Low Energy peripheral using Zephyr RTOS, implementing encrypted advertising with EAD, connection handling, security, and advertising management.

methods.name: read_key_material
methods.description: Reads key material attribute over GATT.

methods.name: update_ad_data
methods.description: Encrypts and updates advertising data with encrypted payloads.

methods.name: set_ad_data
methods.description: Sets advertising data by calling update_ad_data.

methods.name: rpa_expired_cb
methods.description: Callback for RPA address expiration, triggers ad data update.

methods.name: create_adv
methods.description: Creates a Bluetooth advertising instance with specific parameters.

methods.name: stop_and_delete_adv
methods.description: Stops and deletes the advertising instance.

methods.name: init_bt
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth subsystem and security callbacks.

methods.name: run_peripheral_sample
methods.description: Main function to run the BLE peripheral sample with security and advertising.
